fields.description: The client's business or product name.
fields.label: Business Name

fields.description: Industry / market the client operates in.
fields.label: Industry

fields.description: Draft = still being filled in. Ready = the agent may generate from it. Directions Generated = the agent has produced Brand Direction records for it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: What the business does, in the client's own words.
fields.label: What They Do

fields.description: Who the brand needs to speak to (age, role, market, mindset).
fields.label: Target Audience

fields.description: Vibe words from the questionnaire — e.g. 'bold, playful, premium' or 'calm, clinical, trustworthy'.
fields.label: Brand Personality

fields.description: Competitors the client named (what to stand apart from).
fields.label: Competitors

fields.description: Colors the client likes or explicitly hates.
fields.label: Color Preferences

fields.description: Brands, sites, or visuals the client pointed to as inspiration.
fields.label: Inspirations

fields.description: Anything else from the questionnaire that doesn't fit above.
fields.label: Notes

fields.description: The RandomPack Onboarding Brief docname this brief was ingested from (the cross-system correlation key, present on both payment.received and project.created). Empty for briefs created directly in Friday.
fields.label: RandomPack Brief Ref

fields.description: The RandomPack Project docname this brief drives. Set on project.created. Used to write progress/deliverables back to RandomPack (the engine bridge resolves task docnames via get_project on this ref). Empty until project.created arrives.
fields.label: RandomPack Project Ref

fields.description: Design 77: the LOCAL Friday Project record this brief belongs to. Set on project.created after the local Project is inserted. Lets phase_dispatcher._project_of() carry the Project docname onto every engine Task — so the Project's task rollup, Raven channel routing, and share-deliverables all see which Project a Brief drives. Fieldname is 'project' (not 'friday_project') because phase_dispatcher reads work_item.get('project') via meta.has_field('project').
fields.label: Friday Project

fields.description: Design 75 pipeline state. Driven by the Frappe Workflow attached to this brief (Strategy → Naming → ... → Delivered) and the metadata engine. Distinct from the intake `status` field above (which only tracks whether the questionnaire is filled in). Read-only — the engine and the gate transitions move it.
fields.label: Pipeline State

fields.description: The brand direction the client chose at Gate 1. Set when the gate is approved; the build-out phase reads it.
fields.label: Chosen Direction
